en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a European spa town or riverside promenade. In the foreground is a dirt road with pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing and a horse‑drawn carriage. A narrow stream or canal runs along the right with a low bridge and railing. Modest single‑story buildings line the left bank, while on the right a long row of ornate multi‑story townhouses rises above a high retaining wall. In the hazy background on a hill stands a large romantic‑style château or spa complex with towers. A large wall advertisement on one of the tall buildings promotes a bottled drink labelled "Krondorfer Sauerbrunn".
